title: How the relationship changed
description: Chronological trails connect real positions on two numeric axes, preserving reversals, gaps and the final supplied reading.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, tone?, observations } series. Observations are { id, label, time, x, y }, with unique nonempty IDs within each series and finite strictly increasing times. Series IDs are unique and nonempty. Either coordinate may reverse, be signed or be zero. Missing/nonfinite coordinate pairs are omitted and counted, and break connections. Only a complete final supplied observation receives a filled latest dot. No interpolation across missing observations.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned observation period or reporting context.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Horizontal measure and unit, shared across series; defaults to X.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Vertical measure and unit, shared across series; defaults to Y.

props.name: xFormatter
props.description: Formats horizontal coordinates in ticks, inspection and final readings. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: yFormatter
props.description: Formats vertical coordinates in ticks, inspection and final readings. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
